def rot90_ccw(g):
    return [[g[j][i] for j in range(len(g)-1, -1, -1)] for i in range(len(g))]

def rot180(g):
    return [row[::-1] for row in g[::-1]]

def transpose(g):
    return [[g[j][i] for j in range(len(g))] for i in range(len(g[0]))]

def tv_flip(g):
    return transpose(g)[::-1]

def transform_6to12(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    output = [[0 for _ in range(2*n)] for _ in range(2*n)]
    
    for r in range(n):
        for c in range(n):
            output[r][c] = grid[r][c]
    
    for r in range(n):
        for c in range(n):
            output[r][n+c] = rot90_ccw(grid)[r][c]
    
    for r in range(n):
        for c in range(n):
            output[n+r][c] = tv_flip(grid)[r][c]
    
    for r in range(n):
        for c in range(n):
            output[n+r][n+c] = rot180(grid)[r][c]
    
    return output
